speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation and have a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes; have you noticed any abdominal pain, changes in your urine or stool color, or a recent history of heavy alcohol use or new medication intake?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely viral, possibly Hepatitis A or B given the high-risk sexual behavior, with secondary agitation due to hyperammonemia).
